result.brief: 提出 HF-WM 动作条件世界模型，用双分支视频生成与稳定 pointflow 统一人类/机器人运动表征，并通过 GRPO 后训练建模失败动力学。
result.reason: Action-conditioned world model with dual-branch video generation plus pointflow motion representation bridging human-robot embodiment gap; failure-aware post-training. Directly a world-model and representation contribution.
